summary: Emergency access reaches Active Directory in seconds, however many servers you have.

fixes.title: Critical AD groups sync in seconds
fixes.text: The hybrid worker keeps critical groups such as Domain Admins in sync within about 20-30 seconds, however many servers you have.
fixes.action: On a hybrid worker installed before this version, run the hybrid worker setup's Layout step once.

fixes.title: New AD accounts and groups within seconds
fixes.text: A new or changed AD admin account or AD group is created or updated in Active Directory within seconds of the commit.

fixes.title: Server groups sync in parallel
fixes.text: Per-server admin groups are read in parallel batches, adjustable under Settings > Hybrid AD & workloads.

fixes.title: Job timing counts from the finish
fixes.text: A job is next due its interval after it finished, never while it is still running. The Jobs page says so.
